Who We Are

A journey that began in 2015

CookSmart Premium Food started its journey in 2015 in the food processing sector, under the able guidance and leadership of Mr Santanu Saha. Since then there has been no looking back — our current turnover touches around ₹90 crore, with our own production.

With the changing business scenario and competition, there is a revolutionary change in consumers’ perception of buying habits and needs.

Our Philosophy

The internal power of creativity

With the changing business scenario and competition, there is a revolutionary change in consumers’ perception of buying habits and needs.

CookSmart believes in the internal power of creativity in moulding minds — combining this power with a proper understanding of market dynamics, and engineering a creative strategy that not only helps us consolidate but also puts us way ahead of the competition.

Our endless journey towards ultimate quality and excellence, for better consumer satisfaction, inspires us to keep improving on our present best.

What Drives Us

Vision, Mission & Values

Vision

An outstanding company with innovative brands and exceptional people that together really make a difference.

Mission

Be it machinery, technology or people, CookSmart believes in the spirit of excellence, with an unwavering commitment to quality in every sphere — so that the society in which we live and work regards us with belief and confidence.

Values

Our core values are our core beliefs on how we want to run the business, and an integral part of how we do business. They help the business deliver results.
